name: fire-duck-ext-wasm-validation
description: WASM validation tests for the fire_duck_ext DuckDB extension
comment: @duckdb/duckdb-wasm must bundle the same DuckDB MINOR as the extension build (currently 1.5.x). Stable releases still bundle 1.4.x, so a 1.33.1-dev* build (DuckDB 1.5.4) is pinned here. Bump to a stable 1.5.x when one ships. Check with: node -e "...createDuckDB...getVersion()".
